get.description: Returns tenant-scoped locations ordered with the primary location first, with pagination and optional search or active-state filtering.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search across name, address, and city.

post.description: Creates a location, assigns the creating administrator, and applies plan and primary-location rules. Requires the admin role.

delete.description: Deletes a non-primary location without future active appointments and reassigns resources when possible. Requires the admin role.

get.description: Returns a tenant-scoped location with assigned users and related-resource counts.

patch.description: Updates supplied location fields and maintains the single-primary-location rule. Requires the admin role.

delete.description: Removes one or more location assignments and non-owner location-channel memberships. Requires the admin role.

get.summary: List users assigned to a location
get.description: Returns flattened user records with roles, primary-location state, and assignment time.

post.description: Assigns organization users to the location and optionally makes it their primary location. Requires the admin role.

get.summary: List locations accessible to the current user
get.description: Returns the current user's assigned locations and identifies their primary assignment.
